findings.title: Consumables - surgical gloves, drapes, bandages cut as non-payable
findings.why: Your policy has a consumables benefit, so this should be paid.

findings.title: Sub-limit applied on Knee implant
findings.why: Your policy wording has no sub-limit for this.

findings.title: Physiotherapy sessions cut with no reason
findings.why: No reason was given. The insurer must explain this deduction in writing.

findings.title: Settlement adds up
findings.why: Claimed − deductions − co-pay = ₹2,81,500, matching the approved amount.

findings.title: Hospital discount on the cut portion
findings.why: The hospital gave a ₹18,500 discount on a ₹3,70,000 bill. Your proportional share on the ₹70,000 that was cut is about ₹3,500. Ask the insurer to show the discount was passed on to you.

explanations_en.0: The deduction of ₹22,000 for consumables is incorrect because your policy covers them. You can claim this money back from the insurer.
explanations_en.1: The ₹40,000 deduction using a knee implant sub-limit is wrong, as your policy has no such limit. You can claim this money back.
explanations_en.2: A cut of ₹8,000 for physiotherapy was made without any reason. You should ask the insurer to give a written explanation for this deduction.
explanations_en.3: The math for the settlement of ₹0 deduction adds up properly, with the approved amount matching ₹2,81,500. This cut is correct.
explanations_en.4: Hospital gave a ₹18,500 discount on the ₹3,70,000 bill, so your share on the cut ₹70,000 is ₹3,500. You should ask the insurer for written proof that this discount was passed on to you.

explanations_hi.0: कंज्यूमेबल्स के काटे गए ₹22,000 गलत हैं क्योंकि आपकी पॉलिसी में यह कवर है। आप यह पैसे बीमा कंपनी से वापस मांग सकते हैं।
explanations_hi.1: घुटने के इम्प्लांट पर सब-लिमिट लगाकर काटे गए ₹40,000 गलत हैं, क्योंकि आपकी पॉलिसी में ऐसी कोई सीमा नहीं है। आप यह पैसे वापस ले सकते हैं।
explanations_hi.2: फिजियोथेरेपी के ₹8,000 बिना किसी कारण के काट लिए गए हैं। आपको बीमा कंपनी से इसका लिखित कारण मांगना चाहिए।
explanations_hi.3: कटौती के ₹0 का हिसाब बिल्कुल सही बैठता है और यह स्वीकृत ₹2,81,500 से पूरी तरह मेल खाता है। यह कटौती बिल्कुल सही है।
explanations_hi.4: अस्पताल ने ₹3,70,000 के बिल पर ₹18,500 की छूट दी थी, जिसमें से काटे गए ₹70,000 पर आपका हिस्सा ₹3,500 बनता है। आपको बीमा कंपनी से लिखित में पूछना चाहिए कि क्या यह छूट आपको मिली है।

escalation.step: Complaint to the insurer's Grievance Redressal Officer
escalation.text: Insurers must resolve a complaint within 14 days, with reasons referring to the policy terms.
escalation.source_title: IRDAI Master Circular on Protection of Policyholders' Interests, 5 Sep 2024 (as reported)

escalation.step: Escalate on Bima Bharosa (IRDAI's grievance portal) if there's no reply or you disagree
escalation.text: Register the unresolved complaint on bimabharosa.irdai.gov.in.
Usually allowed once the insurer has rejected the complaint or not replied within one month, and within one year of the insurer's reply.
escalation.todo: Confirm the one-month / one-year limits in the Rules text.
